summary: This bill amends the Food Security Act of 1985 to reduce the maximum federal cost-share for certain conservation practices under the Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP), lower the overall payment limitation for producers, and require annual reports to Congress on program obligations.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP) by reducing the maximum payment percentage for certain practices from 75% to 40% and lowering the overall payment limitation per producer from $450,000 to $150,000. These changes are designed to decrease the amount of federal funds disbursed through the program, thus reducing government spending.
